subject: Password reset email never shows up

notes: Reset email → login_issue, not email_delivery. Fully blocked → high. Mistyped email copied as written.

subject: New phone, can't get 2FA codes

notes: Fully blocked → high.

subject: Okta SAML setup failing

subject: Change my email address
body: Hi, I'm moving jobs and need my account email changed from maria.lopez@oldco.com to maria.lopez@gmail.com. Thanks!
notes: Old email is the current login.

body: One of our team members left the company last week. How do I remove her access and move the projects she owned to me? We're on workspace ID ws_4471.
notes: A how-to about managing users → user_management, not how_to_question. Removing access and moving ownership are both user_management, so not multi-intent. Urgency corrected normal → low (v1.3 review): it's a how-to with no blocker, which spec §6.1 defines as low.

subject: Close our workspace
body: We've moved to a different tool and won't need this anymore. Please delete our workspace harbor-labs.ourapp.com and everything in it.
notes: Deletion with no legal framing → account_closure.

subject: Charged after I cancelled
body: I cancelled on March 2 (your agent confirmed it in ticket #39120) but I was still charged $29 on March 15, transaction ch_3PqX81LkT. Please reverse it.
notes: Two references; the charge ID is more relevant to unexpected_charge than the old ticket number.

subject: Refund for annual plan?
body: We bought the annual Pro plan two weeks ago (invoice INV-88412) but the team decided not to adopt it. Is a prorated refund possible? Account acct_19xk4.
notes: Valid charge, wants money back → refund_request.

body: We need 5 more seats on our Business plan, and while you're at it can we switch from monthly to annual billing? Workspace is fernhill.ourapp.com
notes: Two requests, both plan_change → not multi-intent.

subject: Don't renew
body: Please turn off auto-renew for our subscription. We'll use it until the end of the current term. Account ID: acct_66ab0

subject: URGENT - account will be suspended
body: Our renewal payment failed because the company card expired. The banner says the account will be suspended in 24 hours. How do I update the card? acme-logistics.ourapp.com
notes: A how-to about billing → payment_failure. Suspension within 24h backs up the URGENT → high.

body: Can you reissue invoice INV-77120 with our VAT number DE289374651 on it? Our finance team can't process it without it.
notes: The VAT number is a billing detail, not an object to look up; the invoice number is the reference.

subject: Need a few more days on the trial

notes: Borderline urgency: the trial ending tomorrow is a deadline within ~24h → high. Could be argued normal.

subject: Dashboard totals are wrong
body: The revenue widget on our dashboard shows $12,400 for last month but the underlying report adds up to $14,950. Everything else seems fine. Error in console says ERR_AGG_TIMEOUT if that helps.

subject: Everything is down
body: Every page gives us a 502 since about 9:40am. All 30 people on our team are blocked and we have a client launch today. Workspace orbit.ourapp.com
notes: A bare HTTP status code (502) is not a reference_id.

body: Reports have gotten really slow this week, the monthly sales report takes about 40 seconds to load now vs 3-4 seconds before. They do load eventually.

subject: Records disappeared
body: About 30 customer records we added yesterday are gone from our CRM view. They're not in trash either. Nobody on the team deleted them. Account acct_2210q.
notes: Data loss the customer has confirmed → critical.

body: Since we reconnected Slack last Tuesday, new task notifications stopped posting to our #ops channel. The integration page says 'Connected'. Tried disconnecting and reconnecting twice.
notes: Slack notifications → integration_issue, not email_delivery. #ops is a channel name, not a reference.

subject: 429s from the API
body: Our sync job started getting 429 Too Many Requests on /v2/contacts even though we're well under the documented limit. Example request ID: req_8f3a91c2. What's the actual limit per API key?
Trying to import a 5,000-row CSV of contacts from HubSpot. It fails at row 1204 with E_IMPORT_ENCODING every time. Any idea what's wrong with the file?
notes: HubSpot is the data's source, not a built-in integration → import_export.

subject: iOS app crashes on launch
body: Since updating to version 4.12 on my iPhone, the app crashes immediately when I open it. The website works fine on my laptop so I'm using that for now.
notes: Web works → mobile only, with a workaround → normal. A version number is not a reference.

body: Our team's daily digest emails and task assignment notifications have been landing in spam for everyone on our Google Workspace since Monday. Can you check your sending setup?
notes: Google Workspace is the customer's email provider, not an integration.

subject: Board view
body: How do I switch my task board from the list layout to a kanban layout? Can't find the option anywhere.
notes: General product usage with no area-specific category.

body: Would love a dark mode for the web app. Staring at the white UI all day is rough on the eyes. Any plans?

subject: The new redesign
body: Been using your product for 3 years. Honestly the new navigation is confusing and it takes me longer to find things than before. Not asking for anything specific, just wanted you to know.

subject: Stored XSS in comments
body: Hi, I'm a security researcher. The task comment field doesn't sanitize SVG uploads, which allows stored XSS that runs for anyone viewing the task. I have a proof of concept and would like to disclose responsibly. Do you have a bug bounty program?
notes: Vulnerability reports are critical (spec §6.1).

subject: Did someone get into my account?
body: I got two 'new login' emails last night from Lagos and then my password stopped working this morning. I didn't do any of that. My email is sam.okafor@proton.me
notes: Can't log in, but because of unknown logins → compromised_account, not login_issue.

subject: GDPR data access request
body: Under Article 15 of the GDPR I request a copy of all personal data you hold about me. My account email is l.fischer@web.de.
notes: The trailing period is not part of the email.

body: We're a nonprofit with about 40 staff. Do you offer nonprofit discounts on the Business plan, and can we get a quote for annual billing?

notes: Auto-reply. The email is a third party's, not an account login.

body: Please cancel my subscription effective immediately. Also, I was charged for this month on the 1st but haven't used it at all — can I get that refunded? acct_90ttr
notes: Multi-intent: cancellation + refund_request (the charge was valid). Neither blocks, so the one stated first wins.

subject: Feature idea + weird login
body: Two things. First, it would be great to have Gantt charts. Second, I noticed a login to my account from a device I don't recognize yesterday — should I be worried?
notes: Severity override: compromised_account beats the feature request even though it's stated second.

subject: THIS IS UNACCEPTABLE
body: The tooltip on the settings page says 'Notifcations'. How does a paid product ship with typos?? Fix it.
notes: Angry tone, cosmetic bug → low.

subject: Refund the difference

subject: Approvals before done

body: Can admins stop guests from downloading attachments? We share boards with clients and I'm worried about files ending up in the wrong hands.
notes: v1.2 rule: 'can admins…' about permissions → area category user_management, not feature_request. How-to with no blocker → low.

subject: Quarterly repeats please

notes: v1.2 rule: says the capability is missing and asks for it → feature_request.

notes: v1.2 rule: resolved outage is not critical; the current ask is a credit → refund_request.

subject: Attachments down for everyone
body: Nobody in our workspace can upload attachments since 10am. Every upload fails with "Storage unavailable". Everything else works. 40 of us need to share site photos today. Workspace: quarry-hill.ourapp.com
notes: v1.2 rule: a whole major feature failing for everyone → service_outage. Error text without a code is not a reference.

subject: Moving up to Business

notes: v1.2 rule: existing customer asking to change plan / how to → plan_change, not sales_inquiry.

body: Our accounts team wants to stop paying by card. Can we switch to paying by bank transfer on invoice from next month? Org ID 77310
notes: v1.2 rule: switching payment method to bank transfer/invoice terms → payment_failure, not invoice_request.
